basic_info.description: The home was recently meticulously remodeled.  You will be flooded with sunlight at the end of your day, as the home faces west.  Once you step into the middle of the home, you will enjoy a fully remodeled kitchen, dining/living room open floor plan.  All windows have been recently replaced.  The kitchen has a gas stove, dishwasher, large amount of cabinets, white custom quartz counter tops, and a dining bar.  The dining area has sliding doors to a large private patio for outdoor space.  Large washer and dryer is in the hallway.  The primary bedroom is large, with a walk in closet.  The primary bathroom has been redesigned for a walk in shower experience and now has a double sink.  The secondary bathroom has a wonderful tub.  One parking space completes this home.  The common areas includes gardens, gym, elevator and more.  A must see!
